kind.description: Kind and Endpoint describe the server after the change (absent when removed).

signIn.description: SignIn is the command that signs in to it, when it needs credentials.

accountOf.description:
AccountOf is, for an account added or removed, the plugin it's an
account of.

readOnly.description: ReadOnly tools run in dry runs; the others are writes (intercepted).

annotated.description: Annotated is whether the tool declares annotations (readOnlyHint) at all.

items.description: PluginTool is one of a plugin's tools, as a routine would see it.

needsSignIn.description:
NeedsSignIn means it couldn't be tried further without credentials
(`auth login <name>`, then `plugins check <name>`).

trial.description: Trial is what trying it found (adds only).

title: procauto plugins remove --json
description: PluginChange is the output of `plugins add/remove --json`.
